prompt: Create a high-resolution realistic vertical 4:5 fashion editorial photo of a cheerful young woman standing in a warm yellow subway station, framed inside a large semi-transparent rounded-corner social app invitation card overlay. The subject is a cute young East Asian woman with long wavy dark brown hair and soft bangs, smiling directly at the camera with a bright youthful expression. She wears white over-ear headphones, one hand touching the headphones, the other holding a small metallic silver backpack; pose her standing on one leg with the other leg bent backward playfully. Outfit: exactly 6 main visible fashion pieces: a dark burgundy sleeveless zip-front crop athletic top with white side panels, a layered white ruffle mini skirt over pale gray shorts, tall white knee socks, chunky silver-gray sneakers, white over-ear headphones, and a small glossy silver backpack. Background: an outdoor/above-ground subway platform or station corridor with yellow walls, yellow bench seating, safety signs, glass panels, metal rails, and a blurred passing train behind her, sunny late-afternoon lighting, shallow depth of field, crisp realistic skin and fabric details. Add one large centered UI card overlay with rounded corners and off-white header/footer; the woman appears inside and slightly in front of the card for a 3D cutout effect. The card contains exactly 5 visible UI text/icon elements at the top: bold black title “Share”, spaced gray subtitle “GOOD VIBES”, one small yellow sparkle icon on the left, one yellow sun icon on the right, and two small gray dot separators around the subtitle. At the bottom of the card, include exactly 2 large choice buttons: gray “Decline” on the left and golden yellow “Accept” on the right. Style should feel like a vibrant youth music video still, clean commercial photography, glossy social-media dating-card aesthetic, natural proportions, no collage, no extra panels, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张高分辨率、写实的 4:5 竖版时尚大片，画面中一位开朗的年轻女性站在温暖的黄色地铁站内，被框在一个大型半透明圆角社交应用邀请卡片覆盖层中。主体为 一位可爱的东亚年轻女性，留着深棕色长卷发和柔和的刘海，正对着镜头露出明亮青春的笑容。她戴着白色头戴式耳机，一只手轻触耳机，另一只手拿着一个小巧的银色金属质感双肩包；姿势为单脚站立，另一条腿俏皮地向后弯曲。服装：包含 6 件主要可见的时尚单品：深酒红色无袖拉链运动短款上衣（带白色侧边）、叠层白色荷叶边迷你裙（内搭浅灰色短裤）、白色长筒袜、厚底银灰色运动鞋、白色头戴式耳机以及一个小巧的亮面银色双肩包。背景：户外/地面地铁站台或车站走廊，配有黄色墙壁、黄色长椅、安全标志、玻璃面板、金属栏杆，身后有模糊的列车经过，午后阳光明媚，浅景深，皮肤和织物细节清晰写实。添加一张居中的大型 UI 卡片覆盖层，带有圆角和米白色页眉/页脚；女性主体出现在卡片内部并略微突出于卡片前方，形成 3D 剪纸效果。卡片顶部包含 5 个可见的 UI 文字/图标元素：加粗黑色标题“分享”、带间距的灰色副标题“好心情”、左侧一个小黄色闪光图标、右侧一个黄色太阳图标，以及副标题周围的两个灰色小圆点分隔符。卡片底部包含 2 个大型选择按钮：左侧灰色的“拒绝”和右侧金黄色的“接受”。整体风格应呈现出充满活力的青春音乐录影带剧照感，干净的商业摄影风格，具有亮眼的社交媒体交友卡片美学，比例自然，无拼贴，无额外面板，无水印。
